facts.fact: The Local Government Service signed an MoU with Celltel Networks Limited, reported 3 September 2026, to strengthen its IT infrastructure, with improved connectivity of local government offices among its expected results; the article gives no signing date, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Local Government Service and Celltel Networks MoU on IT infrastructure

facts.fact: At the signing, reported 3 September 2026, the Head of the Local Government Service described the present state as 'disconnected offices' from which the Service is moving; he gave no count of offices, and the article gives no date for the remark beyond its own.
facts.system: Local Government Service and Celltel Networks MoU on IT infrastructure

facts.fact: The IT infrastructure upgrade is the Local Government Service's own, with Celltel Networks Limited named as its strategic private partner under the MoU reported 3 September 2026.
facts.system: Local Government Service and Celltel Networks MoU on IT infrastructure

facts.fact: The article on the Local Government Service and Celltel Networks MoU, published 3 September 2026, states no value, term or source of finance.
facts.system: Local Government Service and Celltel Networks MoU on IT infrastructure
